card.name: Inside new brand drug names
card.fires_on: A single letter or short piece inside an invented brand drug name, usually in capitals, such as the V in XPOVIO or the J in PERJETA. It appears in dosing, warning and adverse reaction sections.

modes.label: Capitalized brand names
modes.description: A letter inside an all-caps brand name used as the subject of a dosing or warning sentence.
modes.example: Table 2: XPO<<V>>IO Dosage Modification Guidelines for Hemat

modes.label: Mixed-case brand names
modes.description: A short piece partway through a brand name written in normal capitalization.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE No specific information is available on the treatment of overdosage of Bele<<oda>>q.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated name fragments, so the pole seems to help continue an unusual brand name.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a made-up brand drug name, before the rest of the name is spelled out.
